description:
Ride with Confidence, Every Day

Coming Soon
The Corsa Cross200 Step-Through is currently being prepared for release. Product images and specifications shown on this page represent the planned production model and may be updated before the bike becomes available.
At Corsa, we believe a comfortable bicycle encourages people to ride more often. The Cross200 Step-Through is designed around that idea, offering an easy-to-use hybrid bike for commuting, neighborhood rides, fitness cycling, and everyday recreation.
Its low step-through frame, upright riding position, and dependable components are intended to make every ride feel natural, comfortable, and approachable.

A Frame Designed Around Accessibility
The Cross200 Step-Through is built for riders who value convenience as much as performance.
The low step-through frame makes getting on and off the bike easier when stopping frequently during city rides, carrying bags, or simply choosing a bicycle that feels more comfortable to use every day.
Rather than being designed for a specific type of rider, the step-through frame offers a practical solution for anyone who prefers easier access and a more relaxed riding experience.

Built for Everyday Riding
The planned production model combines a lightweight aluminum frame with Shimano drivetrain components, Tektro brakes, front suspension, and durable 700C wheels.
Every component has been selected to provide dependable everyday performance, straightforward maintenance, and long-term reliability.

Shimano 21-Speed Drivetrain
The Shimano 21-speed drivetrain provides a wide gear range for city streets, moderate hills, and recreational rides.
Shimano EZ-FIRE PLUS integrated shifters make gear changes smooth and intuitive while helping riders maintain a comfortable cadence throughout changing terrain.

Lightweight Aluminum Step-Through Frame
The lightweight aluminum frame offers responsive handling while resisting corrosion for years of everyday use.
Its upright geometry promotes a relaxed riding position that helps reduce strain during longer rides while making everyday cycling more enjoyable.

Front Suspension Fork
The suspension fork helps absorb expansion joints, rough pavement, and uneven bike paths, creating a smoother ride across a variety of everyday riding surfaces.

Reliable Tektro V-Brakes
Front and rear Tektro alloy V-brakes provide dependable stopping performance with simple, low-maintenance operation.
Their predictable braking feel makes them well suited for commuting, neighborhood rides, and recreational cycling.

700C Wheels Built for Everyday Riding
The 700C wheels roll efficiently on pavement while remaining stable on bike paths and hard-packed gravel.
Kenda 700×35C tires provide an excellent balance of rolling efficiency, everyday comfort, and dependable traction.

Ideal For
The Cross200 Step-Through is well suited for:

It is designed for everyday transportation and recreation but is not intended for technical mountain biking, downhill riding, or jumping.
